items.title: General triple q-series transformation via analytic q-expansion and an operator extension of Sears transformation
items.author: Zhi-Guo Liu
items.source_version: Official SIGMA20(2024),086; publisher final form September15,2024; published October4,2024
items.difficulty_reason: Extends Sears transformation by a q-exponential differential operator and combines it with analytic q-expansion to transform the general triple series. Both complete local operator and analytic derivations remain as the main proof, with absolute convergence preserved; the extended Sears theorem and many specializations are not separate tasks.

primary.label: Complete general triple q-series transformation statement with absolute-convergence condition

proof_spans.label: Complete local analytic q-expansion derivation and terminating-series supporting arguments
Complete q-exponential operator/extended Sears derivation and principal triple-transformation proof

contexts.label: Complete author notation, convergence setup and prior summation prerequisites
Author special cases and proof roadmap, not separately counted
Remaining full author number-theory/Rogers-Hecke applications and specializations, acknowledgements; uncounted
